crack attack
It was my first day at work and it was just me and this guy.  He asked if I wanted to smoke a joint and I didn't want to look like a pussy so I decided to.  I had two huge hits with him and then realized that the boss was coming back and so I put the joint down.  It came on almost instant and I had no idea. At first I thought I had broncitis because my entire throat just filled up with flem, I tried to cough it up and it came out in a huge mound.  My lungs and mouth felt weird and I went outside to try and hack up what was in my throat and all of a sudden it hit me in about 2 seconds.  I was higher than I have ever been in my life.  I felt like I needed to run and I ran back to where we smoked, I felt my pulse and it was three times the normal.  I knew I had somethin that was laced and I said 'did you put fuckin dope in here' he just smiled and said 'it'll go away in a minute don't worry'  I was paranoid as hell.  I found somewhere to sit and I sat down because I felt like I was gonna puke.  I had the biggest head rush on the face of the planet and it was so intense my head was hurting.  When I sat down my legs started twitching so bad and I was gettin spasms in my arms a little and my stomache/chest.  I thought I was gonna have a seizure because I just couldn't keep my legs still.  My heart was so fast I thought I had done tweek.  I tried to call some friends, and when I finally got a hold of someone my heartrate was so fast that I couldn't talk right.
This was the worst high ever.  I felt so sick and my heart was so fast.  I had a friend try and talk me down they kept saying 'walk slow, take slow steps' but I couldn't.  It was pysically impossible.  I could take a few slow steps but then I just had to walk as fast as my heart was beating.  I had taken two incredible hits and was high as hell.  When I finally started coming down I felt sick.
It's the next day and they said it was crack and even though I hate it I fuckin want it again.  I can not believe this, I'm not sure if its my mind playin tricks on me but I want some more.
